'''Laevatain''' is a 6★ [[Heat]] [[Striker]] [[Operator]] from [[Rhodes Island]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''. She is a [[Sword]] user with outstanding mass DMG skills. Her Final Strikes can absorb {{G|Heat Infliction|Heat Inflictions}} from nearby enemies to trigger powerful battle skills and combo skills. She can also use her ultimate to carve and burn her way through mobs of enemies.

==Profile==
"Let that twilight burn!"<br/>Laevatain is a [[Rhodes Island]] operator who joined Endfield at the [[Endministrator]]'s direct recommendation. Under the framework agreement between the two companies, she serves as an operator directly under the Endministrator's command.<br/>Before joining [[Endfield Industries]], Laevatain roamed the world alone, pursuing a goal she could call her own. Because of that journey, and her formidable skill in solo combat, people often mistake her for "someone you can't talk to." In truth, the opposite is closer to reality. It's only that her earnest, forthright nature sometimes comes across too strongly, giving rise to misunderstanding.<br/>At times, though, she speaks in ways that confound others, often circling back to the subject of "memory," as if she were purposefully trying to separate herself from who she is.<br/>She often wields flames, yet craves ice cream just as much. To her, maybe that contradiction feels perfectly natural.<br/>"Try getting closer to me if you're still feeling cold."
